scope.summary: The old target needs maintenance. It leaks the parser when parsing reports an error, and it cannot exercise cleanup of a saved comment after a parse error. The remaining selected change is unreachable through this entry.

assessments.reason: The added null assignment is in the no-object branch for a pending comment. On this entry's add-string path, parsing starts in INIT and creates a top object before reaching that trailing branch, including when comments consume the input. A preexisting top object also excludes the branch.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: INIT creates the top object before the trailing pending-comment handling.
A nonempty UCL chunk enters the state machine.

assessments.reason: The new cleanup handles a saved, unattached comment when a parser is freed after an error. A finite input such as #x followed by a newline and an unterminated quoted key can leave that pending comment on the error path when comment saving is enabled. The old target creates the parser with flags 0 and returns on a reported error before calling ucl_parser_free, so it has no equivalent route to this cleanup.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: A line comment is saved only with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.
A quoted key invokes the quoted-string lexer and propagates its failure.
An unterminated quoted string produces a parser error.

build.reason: The supplied recipe builds the Autotools library and compiles and links this entry against libucl.a; the library source list includes both changed source files. This assesses the recipe, without claiming an observed build result.

evidence.dependency_reason: The library recipe includes ucl_parser.c and ucl_util.c.

input.reason: The entry skips zero-size data and passes an explicit positive byte length, avoiding add_string_priority's strlen path for len 0.

evidence.dependency_reason: Only a zero length makes the API call strlen on the data.

lifecycle.reason: The parser is allocated per nonempty input, but a parser error makes the entry return before freeing it. This is a preexisting parser-lifetime failure.

evidence.dependency_reason: ucl_parser_new allocates the parser returned to the entry.
A recorded parser error makes the entry's error check nonnull.
ucl_parser_free releases the parser and its owned state.

control_flow.reason: For nonempty input, the entry calls add_string, which delegates through add_string_priority and add_chunk_priority to UCL parsing; it then queries the error and reaches free on the success path. The error-path cleanup failure is assessed under lifecycle.

evidence.dependency_reason: add_string delegates with the parser's default priority.
The delegated call selects the UCL state machine for nonempty data.

blockers.requirement: Exercise ucl_parser_free with a saved, unattached comment after parsing stops with an error.
blockers.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput -> ucl_parser_new with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS -> ucl_parser_add_string on a line comment followed by an unterminated quoted key -> ucl_parser_free on the error path.
blockers.failure_condition: The old entry fixes parser flags at 0 and returns when ucl_parser_get_error is nonnull, so the new last_comment cleanup cannot run.
blockers.alternative_paths: Natural bytes cannot enable the parser flag; the entry has one parser setup and its only free call is after the error return.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser is initialized with the caller's flags and creates comment storage only when comment saving is enabled.
The comment is saved before parsing the following key.
An unterminated quoted key supplies a finite error trigger.
A recorded error is visible to the entry's check.

blockers.failure_condition: A reported error takes the return at harness line 20 before the free at line 23, leaving the allocated parser and owned state unreleased.
blockers.alternative_paths: The complete entry has no other cleanup call or ownership transfer on the error branch.
